fiche: Petit scarabée joufflu qui roule des boulettes de terre dans les prairies et les sous-bois.
apparence: Chubby beetle with a domed shiny shell split down the middle, stubby legs and a round face; glossy black, acid green and yellow spots.

stades.bebe: A round shiny black bean with big yellow eyes, two tiny antenna nubs and four stubby feet.
stades.enfant: Its shell splits into two green-spotted wing cases and a small blunt horn appears on its nose.
stades.ado: Body grows longer and sturdier, the nose horn becomes a curved spike and thick spiked forelegs appear.
stades.adulte: A heavy armored beetle with a huge forked rhinoceros horn, broad acid-green wing cases and clawed legs that push a giant earth ball.
stades.ancien: Its shell is cracked and covered in moss and tiny flowers, the horn is chipped and ringed with old golden bands.

fiche: Puceron rond comme une cerise qui sirote la sève des plantes dans les jardins sauvages.
apparence: Plump soft aphid shaped like a cherry with a leaf-like stem on its head and tiny legs; cherry purple, lime green and glossy black.

stades.bebe: A tiny round purple droplet with huge black eyes and a little green stem sprouting from its head.
stades.enfant: Six tiny green legs and a pair of short antennae appear under its round body.
stades.ado: Its body becomes pear-shaped, two little nectar tubes grow on its back and its stem opens into a leaf.
stades.adulte: A big glossy cherry-like bug with translucent lime wings folded on its back, nectar tubes dripping sweet syrup and leafy antennae.
stades.ancien: Its skin is wrinkled like a dried cherry, its leaf has turned amber and a halo of tiny sugar crystals floats around it.

fiche: Fourmi ouvrière qui marche debout et porte des charges dix fois plus lourdes qu'elle dans les canyons.
apparence: Upright ant with a segmented body, big jaws and strong arms; glossy black, rust orange and yellow.

stades.bebe: A round black head on a tiny pill body with big eyes and two wobbly antennae, standing on two little feet.
stades.enfant: Its body splits into three segments and two small arms with round mittens appear.
stades.ado: Legs and arms lengthen, small orange mandibles grow and it carries a pebble on its back.
stades.adulte: A muscular upright ant with huge crushing mandibles, four powerful arms and a thick orange-banded abdomen, lifting a boulder overhead.
stades.ancien: Its armor is scratched and dusty, one antenna is bent, and it wears a yellow foreman scarf and leans on a stone pickaxe.

fiche: Papillon de nuit aux ailes de velours sombre qui danse autour des lumières dans la brume.
apparence: Fuzzy moth with velvet wings marked with eye patterns and feathery antennae; deep purple, black and pale yellow.

stades.bebe: A fuzzy round purple caterpillar ball with big shiny eyes and two tiny feathery tufts.
stades.enfant: Two small stubby black wings sprout from its back and its tufts become short feathery antennae.
stades.ado: Its body slims, wings grow large with yellow eye spots and a fluffy collar appears around its neck.
stades.adulte: A large elegant moth with wide velvet wings covered in glowing yellow eye patterns, a thick fur mane and long feathered antennae.
stades.ancien: Its wings are frayed at the edges like old lace, its fur turns silver and faint glowing dust trails behind it.

fiche: Cloporte câlin qui se roule en boule sous les pierres humides des ruines et des cryptes.
apparence: Pill bug with overlapping curved armor plates and many small legs, able to roll into a ball; slate grey, glossy black and pale yellow.

stades.bebe: A small grey ball with three soft plates, two big eyes peeking out and a row of tiny feet.
stades.enfant: It unrolls into an oval with more plates, two short antennae and two little tail prongs.
stades.ado: Its plates become thick and shiny black with yellow rims and its legs grow longer and more numerous.
stades.adulte: A heavy armored isopod with layered stone-like plates edged in yellow, spiked tail prongs and a row of strong legs, able to roll into a boulder.
stades.ancien: Its plates are covered in moss and lichen, one carries a carved rune, and small mushrooms grow on its back.

fiche: Tique gonflée comme un ballon qui flotte lentement dans les marais en faisant tic-tac.
apparence: Balloon-like tick with an inflated glossy body, a small hard head and dangling legs; dark purple, glossy black and acid green.

stades.bebe: A tiny round black seed with huge green eyes and four little dangling legs.
stades.enfant: Its body swells into a small purple balloon and two short barbed mouthparts appear.
stades.ado: Its balloon body grows large with green vein patterns, eight legs dangle below and it starts to float.
stades.adulte: A big floating tick with a glossy inflated purple belly lined with glowing green veins, a hard black shield head with hooked jaws and eight clawed dangling legs.
stades.ancien: Its balloon is patched and scarred, its shield head is crowned with old bone fragments and a faint green glow ticks like a clock inside it.

fiche: Araignée noire qui tisse des toiles de soie sombre dans les cryptes et les ruines oubliées.
apparence: Eight-legged spider with a round abdomen, many eyes and silk spinners; glossy black, deep purple and acid green markings.

stades.bebe: A round fuzzy black puffball with two big eyes, four tiny eye dots and four stubby legs.
stades.enfant: It gets eight thin legs and a small purple abdomen with a green dot pattern.
stades.ado: Its abdomen grows large with a green hourglass mark, fangs appear and silk threads trail from its back.
stades.adulte: A large spider with long jointed legs ending in hooks, eight glowing green eyes, curved fangs and a huge purple abdomen spinning a dark web cape.
stades.ancien: Its legs are wrapped in grey web like bandages, its eyes glow dim silver and old relics hang caught in its silk mantle.

fiche: Mante religieuse escrimeuse aux bras en lames qui guette ses proies immobile dans la jungle.
apparence: Upright praying mantis with a triangular head, long neck and scythe-like forearms; acid green, yellow and black edges.

stades.bebe: A small green bean with a triangle head, huge round eyes and two folded nub arms.
stades.enfant: Its neck stretches and its nub arms become small hooked pincers.
stades.ado: It stands taller on thin legs, its forearms become serrated blades and small leaf-shaped wings appear.
stades.adulte: A tall fencer mantis with long gleaming scythe arms edged in black, wide green leaf wings like a cloak and a crested head.
stades.ancien: Its body turns autumn yellow, its blades are notched from duels and a long antenna beard hangs from its chin.

fiche: Scorpion des dunes au dard brûlant qui se cache sous le sable chaud du désert.
apparence: Armored scorpion with big pincers, segmented tail and glowing stinger; sand yellow, glossy black and orange.

stades.bebe: A round yellow pebble with big eyes, two tiny pincer mittens and a short curly tail.
stades.enfant: Its tail grows into three segments with a small blunt stinger and four pairs of little legs appear.
stades.ado: Its pincers get serrated, black plates cover its back and the stinger becomes sharp and glowing orange.
stades.adulte: A large heavily armored scorpion with massive black pincers, a long segmented tail raised high and a blazing orange stinger.
stades.ancien: Its plates are sand-worn and engraved with desert runes, its stinger glows like an ember and a bead necklace hangs from its claw.

fiche: Mille-pattes géant aux crochets venimeux qui serpente dans les galeries humides et les champignonnières.
apparence: Long segmented centipede with rows of legs, venom claws and antennae; glossy black, purple and yellow leg tips.

stades.bebe: A short chubby worm of three round segments with big eyes and tiny feet.
stades.enfant: Its body grows to six segments, each with yellow-tipped legs, and two long antennae appear.
stades.ado: Its body becomes long and snake-like, purple plates cover each segment and hooked venom claws grow near its head.
stades.adulte: A huge coiling centipede with dozens of glossy black segments, yellow spiked legs, giant purple venom pincers and a horned head.
stades.ancien: Its segments are cracked and moss-filled, some legs are replaced by roots, and its antennae trail like long white whiskers.

fiche: Bourdon bâtisseur qui porte sur son dos une ruche-forteresse où vivent ses petites ouvrières.
apparence: Fluffy bumblebee with a round striped body, small wings and a wax hive built on its back; yellow, black and honey amber.

stades.bebe: A fluffy yellow and black striped ball with big eyes and two tiny buzzing wings.
stades.enfant: Its fur gets thicker, a small stinger appears and a little wax cell grows on its back.
stades.ado: Its wings grow stronger, the wax cells stack into a small tower on its back and its legs carry pollen baskets.
stades.adulte: A big furry bumblebee carrying a honey-amber hive fortress with towers and tiny windows on its back, with armored striped body and a thick stinger.
stades.ancien: Its fur turns grey and shaggy, its hive castle is crumbling and covered in flowers, and honey drips like a beard from its jaws.

fiche: Libellule chevalier à la queue en lance qui patrouille au-dessus des lagons et des orages.
apparence: Slender dragonfly with four long glassy wings, compound eyes and a lance-tipped tail; iridescent acid green, purple and black.

stades.bebe: A small round water nymph with huge bubble eyes and stubby legs.
stades.enfant: Its body stretches, two short glassy wings appear and a tiny pointed tail grows.
stades.ado: It gets four longer veined wings, an iridescent green body and a needle-sharp tail tip.
stades.adulte: A large knight dragonfly with four wide crackling glassy wings, a purple helmet-like head and a long armored tail ending in a spear blade.
stades.ancien: Its wings are clouded with frost patterns, its armor is tarnished bronze and a faint ring of lightning circles its head like a halo.

fiche: Cigale géante dont le chant assourdissant résonne comme une sirène au sommet des volcans.
apparence: Massive cicada with a broad head, wide-set eyes, translucent veined wings and drum-like sound plates on its sides; acid green, glossy black and orange.

stades.bebe: A round brown shell nymph with big eyes, digging claws and a soft belly.
stades.enfant: It cracks out of its shell with small crumpled green wings and two tiny drum plates on its sides.
stades.ado: Its wings unfold with black veins, its drum plates grow big and round and its body becomes thick and broad.
stades.adulte: A colossal four-legged cicada with huge glowing orange drum plates on its flanks, wide clear veined wings and a heavy armored head.
stades.ancien: Its drum plates are cracked like old bells, empty shells of its past molts hang on its back and its wings are patched with amber.

fiche: Cocon vivant de soie dorée qui se métamorphose sans fin au cœur des grottes de cristal.
apparence: Shapeless living cocoon of golden silk threads with a shimmering creature visible inside; gold, deep purple and acid green glow.

stades.bebe: A small fuzzy golden silk lump with two big eyes peeking through the threads.
stades.enfant: Silk tendrils sprout from its body and a purple glow pulses inside it.
stades.ado: Its silk splits open in places revealing folded wings and twitching legs inside a glowing chrysalis.
stades.adulte: A large pulsing golden cocoon mass with silk tendril arms, half-emerged wings of light and many glowing green eyes shining through the threads.
stades.ancien: Its silk turns pale and crystalline, ancient insect relics are woven into it and a halo of floating silk rings surrounds it.

fiche: Souverain colossal de tous les insectes, dont la carapace-couronne abrite un essaim entier.
apparence: Colossal royal beetle-wasp with a crown-shaped carapace housing a swarm, regal mandibles and gauzy wings; glossy black, acid green, gold and purple.

stades.bebe: A round glossy black grub with big gold eyes and a tiny three-point crown nub on its head.
stades.enfant: Six short legs and a small shell appear, and its crown nub becomes three gold spikes.
stades.ado: Its shell splits into green wing cases, sharp mandibles grow and a few tiny insects buzz around its crown.
stades.adulte: A colossal four-legged armored emperor beetle with a towering gold crown carapace full of hive holes, sweeping purple wings, huge sickle mandibles and a swarm orbiting it.
stades.ancien: Its carapace is cracked and overgrown like an old cathedral, its crown is ringed with glowing amber relics and its swarm forms a shining halo.
